theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha' hb' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use _
      exact ⟨.refl _, .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      let ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha' ha''
      let ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb' hb''
      use _
      constructor
      · exact .par ha.1 hb.1
      · exact .par ha.2 hb.2
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha']
      use _
      exact ⟨.red_I _, .refl _⟩
    case red_K =>
      let ⟨a₂', ha₂'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha'
      rw [ha₂'.2]
      use _
      exact ⟨.red_K _ b', ha₂'.1⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      let ⟨a'', c', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha'
      rw [h.2.2]
      use _
      constructor
      · exact .refl _
      · exact .red_S a'' c' b'
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use _
      exact ⟨.refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      use _
      exact ⟨ha, .red_I _⟩
    case red_I =>
      use _
      exact ⟨.refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use _
      exact ⟨.refl _, .red_K _ c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      let ⟨a₁', h'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      rw [h'.2]
      use _
      exact ⟨h'.1, .red_K _ c'⟩
    case red_K =>
      use _
      exact ⟨.refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use _
      exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      let ⟨a', b', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [h.2.2]
      use _
      constructor
      · exact .refl _
      · apply ParallelReduction.par
        · exact .par h.left hc
        · exact .par h.2.1 hc
    case red_S => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _⟩
